rows.label: fig:reliability
rows.before: E-arm logged-reward reliability. rows.after: E-arm logged-reward calibration. Points: bin means; bars: 95\% CIs.

rows.after: A--E code-branch trajectories: medians and interquartile ranges.

rows.after: E-arm state histories: pre-update probabilities (top) and scheduling multipliers (bottom).
